```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The status quo in higher education is not working and needs change.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"New systems of learning are needed to compete with traditional four-year colleges, including expanded community colleges, technical institutions, private training schools, online universities, life-long learning, and work-based learning in the private sector.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"New models for acquiring advanced skills will be ever more important in the rapidly changing economy of the twenty-first century, especially in science, technology, engineering, and math.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Public policy should advance the affordability, innovation, and transparency needed to address challenges in higher education and make accessible to everyone emerging alternatives to traditional college attendance, with their lower cost degrees.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Federal student aid is on an unsustainable path.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Families should be provided with greater transparency and information regarding student loan completion rates, repayment rates, future earnings, and other factors affecting decisions.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The federal government should not originate student loans, but should serve as an insurance guarantor for the private sector offering loans to students.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Private sector participation in student financing should be welcomed.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Any regulation that drives tuition costs higher must be reevaluated to balance its worth against its negative impact on students and their parents.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
